name: branch
title: Branch Planner
description: Align on large engineering projects, investigate hidden risks, and decompose them into dependency-aware branch and PR stacks that can be executed across focused chats or agents.
trigger: Invoke when Ko asks to decompose or branch a large project into multiple PRs, chats, or agents; plan an epic across sequential and parallel workstreams; decide what can run in parallel; freeze a technical branch stack; or execute an established 'Branch N approved, go' plan. Do not invoke for ordinary Git branch commands or a single already-scoped repo task.
